about.behavior: Favors deep, high-relief coral ledges and rocky drop-offs along the outer continental shelf.
about.timing_note: Patterns reported by local captains and fishing writers, not tested by studies.

factor_diagnostics.value_notes: A southeastern U.S. spawning survey recorded spawning scamp at bottom temperatures of 16–27 °C (mean 21.0 °C); a SEDAR assessment describes spawning off the Carolinas at 22–25 °C.
